bullets.text: Ofcom Approves Satellite Services - **Ofcom** greenlights direct-to-device satellite services for smartphones, enhancing connectivity in remote UK areas.
5G Protocol Testing Vital - Continuous **5G** protocol testing ensures seamless connectivity and prevents service disruptions for critical applications.
AI Fuels Telecom Growth - The **AI** revolution is set to drive significant growth in wireless and telecom sectors, enhancing connectivity.
AI Phones Transform Economics - **AI**-enabled smartphones promise to streamline user tasks, shifting the economic landscape of mobile devices.
Telecoms Strategy for 2026 - Focus on **edge AI**, data sovereignty, and monetisation to enhance operational efficiency and compliance.
OpenAI Partners with Deutsche Telekom - **Deutsche Telekom** collaborates with **OpenAI** to enhance AI capabilities across its network operations.
AI-RAN Optimisation Validated - **Samsung** and **KT** demonstrate AI-driven radio access network optimisation, improving service quality in real-time.
2026 Network Outlook - AI-driven workloads will reshape **fibre** planning and network security strategies in the telecom sector.
NTT DATA Expands Cyber Defense - **NTT DATA** launches AI-powered Cyber Defense Centers to enhance cybersecurity resilience in the UK.
T-Mobile's Legal Battle - **T-Mobile** defends its AI onboarding tool against **AT&T**'s lawsuit, emphasizing customer choice and innovation.
